### About Me

I am an undergraduate student at the University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) currently pursuing an Environmental Studies B.S. degree. I am particularly interested in how environmental data analysis and visualization can be used to better understand ecological systems and inform climate change solutions. My research experience with the Cheadle Center for Biodiversity and Ecological Restoration and undergraduate coursework has increased my interest in how data analysis is used for restoration and conservation work. I have also become increasingly interested in marine ecosystems and how they function and contribute to larger ecological stories. 

Outside of academics, I love being outdoors and am often found hiking, surfing, or rock climbing. I also play guitar and am in a band I started with my friends called Publicity Stunt.
